name: H05_hare_apparent_counts_hares_you_control_not_hares_you_own
note: Hare Apparent: 'other creatures you control named Hare Apparent' reads control, not ownership. P0 controls a Hare Apparent that P1 owns (gain_control) and does not control the one it owns (P1 controls it): P0 casts a Hare Apparent and gets exactly one Rabbit (for the borrowed Hare), not zero and not two.
